name: Republic of East Florida (1812–1813)
description: A white field charged with the blue silhouette of a soldier charging with a fixed bayonet, above the motto 'SALUS POPULI LEX SUPREMA' in blue.
history: The Patriot flag designed by Colonel Ralph Isaacs for the American-backed 'Patriots' who seized Fernandina in March 1812 and proclaimed the Republic of East Florida on 17 March 1812, hoping to hand Spanish East Florida to the United States. The flag was raised on 13 or 14 March 1812; the venture collapsed in May 1813 when the Patriots withdrew.

features.role: motto 'Salus populi lex suprema' (the welfare of the people is the supreme law)
